articleChanges.old: Where the older Greek manuscripts read *hos* (ὅς, “He appeared in the flesh”), the Byzantine tradition behind the King James reads *theos* (θεός, "God was manifest in the flesh"), and a smaller group reads the neuter *ho* (ὅ), agreeing grammatically with "mystery."
articleChanges.new: Where Nestle’s 1904 text reads *hos* (ὅς, “He appeared in the flesh”), Robinson–Pierpont and the Textus Receptus edition included here read *theos* (θεός, "God was manifest in the flesh"), while a smaller group reads the neuter *ho* (ὅ), agreeing grammatically with "mystery."
articleChanges.reason: Name the actual displayed editions and distinguish the Byzantine/Majority text from the Textus Receptus.
